title: Comparative Evaluation of Wearable Oxygen-Uptake Estimators Using Baseline-Relative, Transition, and Equivalence Analyses: analysis code and result artefacts
description: Analysis code and result artefacts: data loading for three public datasets (Beltrame et al. 2017; WEEE, Gashi et al. 2022; Ingraham et al. 2019), causal per-participant preprocessing, nested leave-one-participant-out model selection and training of eleven linear, tree and temporal models, baseline-relative, transition-resolved, significance/equivalence and agreement analyses, figure and table generation, per-fold predictions and result tables, and the code of a previous, non-nested version of the analysis. The primary dataset (Beltrame et al. 2017, Scientific Reports 7:45738, CC BY 4.0) is included; the two external datasets are available from their own repositories.
